text:
ashley: quick follow-up from yesterday's RFC sync. proposing a "cost-handshake" pattern where the edge stamps a tiny opaque id and the inference runtime emits a separate "backfill" event with precise counts. want to capture objections before I write the PR.

marta: curious about joinability. if backfills miss the ingest window we still need billing to reconcile. do we plan for realtime joins or offline reconciliation?

devon: realtime joins at query time is hard. prefer a small TTL'd key-value ledger the runtime writes to and billing/offline jobs join against it. ledger semantics: write-once idempotent, ttl 48h, small size per key.

oliver: agree on ledger, but we should avoid sync writes in the hot path that increase p95. batching or write-behind looks safer. infra-bot, ballpark cost?

infra-bot: estimated extra writes = ~1.1k-1.5k/s at p95 for current traffic. recommend micro-batching (500-1000ms window) or using a write-behind cache with conditional puts to avoid duplicate work. consider Dynamo-style store or redis+persist.

ashley: tradeoffs I see:
- edge-only attach: survives sampling and keeps attribution early, but we only have heuristics for tokens.
- runtime-only attach: exact tokens + tool-call merges, but lost if we sample at the edge and drop envelopes.
- handshake (edge id + runtime backfill): best of both but adds a ledger surface and joins.

marta: also privacy/compliance: storing model identifiers in the ledger could be sensitive. we should store model_id hashes or small stable ids and map to full metadata in a restricted job.

devon: agreed. ledger value shape should be minimal: {model_id, token_count, quant_code, batch_count, tool_agg_hash?} but stored as a compact binary or base64 blob to avoid schema drift in the store.

oliver: operational concerns: GC/TTL, cold read perf for billing queries, and debugging UX when backfill missing. we need a reconciliation dashboard that lists missing backfills by key and owner.

ashley: proposed header at edge:
```
X-CR: ck_7Yx9a2  # cost-handshake id (short)
X-Tenant: tenant-acme
```
runtime will write ledger entries keyed by ck_* and also emit an optional enrichment event into the trace stream with a pointer to the ledger key. pipeline will attempt to apply enrichment at ingest and billing will join offline for longer windows.

marta: sounds good. tests: we need a test harness that simulates missing backfills, out-of-order arrival, and ledger expiry to ensure billing reports have graceful degradation.

devon: merging tool tokens: runtime must canonicalize tool contributions into the same ledger key. define merge rules: additive tokens + optional per-tool breakdown map. use deterministic canonicalization so duplicate writes are idempotent.

oliver: also consider a tiny cost-only sample mode: if a customer is quota-sensitive we can keep a 1KB cost-only envelope that we always keep (even when full trace sampled out) so we have a retained cost signal.

ashley: rollout plan draft:
1) flag on edge to emit ck header and telemetry only (no ledger writes) for 2w
2) enable runtime ledger writer in canary with write-behind batching + TTL
3) add ingest pipeline enrichment join + billing offline join job and run reconciliation mode for 7d
4) flip full pipeline on, keep opt-out flag for regulated tenants

marta: i'll own query-side tests and SLO regression checks. add me to the PR.

devon: i'll implement runtime writer + idempotent put semantics (conditional put). will try to keep latency impact <5ms with batching.

oliver: i'll add infra runbook items: storage sizing, ttl metrics, backfill queue, and an alert for backfill success rate <99%.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: detected branch redwood/runtime#1294 - integration tests queued.

ashley: final open questions: 1) exact TTL (48h default?) 2) ledger storage choice (Dynamo vs redis+persist) 3) format (plain JSON vs compact encoded) 4) opt-out/entitlement label naming (console name?)

marta: TTL 48h fine. ledger store: prefer Dynamo for durability and access from billing jobs, but we can front it with a hot cache. format: compact encoded json v1, include version prefix so we can evolve. console name: `cost-handshake` feature flag.

devon: +1 Dynamo + hot cache. include schema version in the record for migrations.

ashley: great. i'll write the PR tomorrow with the edge header change + a simple ledger writer prototype. will post the PR link here once ready. tagging @marta @devon @oliver. :thumbsup:
